blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High frame rate HDR video is important in applications such as autonomous driving and scientific imaging, where rapid motion and extreme illumination often occur simultaneously. Conventional frame cameras face a trade-off between temporal resolution and dynamic range, while event cameras provide complementary high-speed brightness-change measurements over a wide illumination range. These properties have motivated event-based HDR reconstruction, with existing methods broadly following event-only and hybrid event-frame paradigms. Event-only HDR reconstruction, however, suffers from brightness and color drift due to the lack of absolute intensity references. Hybrid event-frame methods alleviate this ambiguity using low-dynamic-range (LDR) frames as anchors, but most perform one-to-one HDR reconstruction at available LDR timestamps. In this work, we investigate single-reference HDR temporal expansion, reconstructing N HDR frames from one LDR reference and events instead of N aligned LDR observations. We develop HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that decomposes the task into event-guided temporal generation and HDR content completion. Because paired real HDR-event data are scarce, we train on synthetic data and adapt the model to real event domains using LDR-event sequences as proxy supervision with teacher-student distillation. Experiments on synthetic and multiple real-world datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction quality and robust real-data adaptation.
blocks.zh: 高帧率的HDR视频在自主驱动和科学成像等应用中很重要,在这些应用中,快速运动和极端发光经常同时发生. 常规框架相机面临时间分辨率和动态范围之间的取舍,而事件相机则在宽光度范围内提供互补的高速亮度变化测量. 这些特性推动了以事件为基础的人类发展报告的重建,现有方法基本上遵循只事件和混合事件框架范式。 然而,由于缺乏绝对的强度参考,仅针对事件的《人类发展报告》重建受到亮度和色彩漂移的影响。 混合事件框架方法以低动态距离(LDR)框架为锚地来缓解这种模糊性,但大多数方法在可用的LDR时间戳下进行一对一的HDR重建. 在这项工作中,我们调查单一参考的《人类发展报告》时间扩展情况,从一个LDD参考和事件重建国家HDR框架,而不是从N一致的LDR观测结果中重建。 我们开发了HIVE-Diff,这是一个以事件为条件的视频传播框架,将任务分解为由事件指导的时间生成和HDR内容完成. 由于配对的HDR-事件数据稀缺,我们进行合成数据培训,并用LDR-事件序列作为代理监督,对模型进行调整,使之适应真实事件域,并配以师生蒸馏. 对合成和多种现实世界数据集的实验表明,重建质量良好,实际数据适应性强。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: High-dynamic-range (HDR) video is important for capturing scenes with extreme lighting while preserving details in both highlights and shadows. Prior research has explored different methods to capture and reconstruct HDR video, such as multi-exposure fusion, learning-based HDR synthesis, and hardware-assisted sensing [ 3 , 20 , 7 , 42 ] . Methods using temporally varying exposures with frame alignment are effective for static and slow scenes, but they may fail to reconstruct HDR content at high-speed scenes. Hardware-based approaches avoid inter-frame alignment using spatially varying exposures or multi-sensor designs, but increase system complexity and often sacrifice spatial resolution, field of view, or readout bandwidth [ 42 , 33 , 40 ] . Together, these limitations make it difficult for conventional frame-based systems to achieve both high dynamic range and high temporal resolution.
blocks.zh: 高能动距离(HDR)视频对于拍摄带有极端照明的场景,同时在亮点和阴影中保存细节都很重要. 先前的研究探索了获取和重建HDR视频的不同方法,如多接触聚变,以学习为基础的HDR合成,硬件辅助感知[3,20,7,42]. 对静态和缓慢的场景,采用时间上不同且框架一致的曝光方法是有效的,但可能无法在高速场景中重建人类发展报告的内容。 以硬件为基础的方法避免采用空间相异的曝光或多传感器设计来进行帧间对接,但增加了系统的复杂性并经常牺牲空间分辨率,视野,或读出带宽[42,33,40]. 这些限制加在一起,使得传统的基于帧的系统难以实现高动态范围并高时间分辨率.

blocks.en: Compared with frame-based methods, event cameras record per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously with microsecond latency [ 10 , 25 ] . This allows them to capture fast motion without blur even at extreme light conditions. Existing event-based HDR methods broadly fall into two categories. Event-only methods reconstruct blur-free, high-speed HDR video directly from event streams. However, this method does not have absolute intensity references and often produces videos with severe color and brightness drifts [ 44 , 58 , 36 , 57 ] . Hybrid event-frame methods instead use synchronous LDR frames as intensity anchors and uses events to compensate for over-/under-exposed contents. While this approach produces HDR videos with high perceptual quality and color fidelity, most existing methods reconstruct HDR content at the timestamps of the available LDR frames [ 50 , 15 , 38 ] .
blocks.zh: 相较于基于帧的方法,事件相机记录出每像素亮度会与微秒潜度同步变化[10,25]. 这使得他们能够捕捉出快速运动,即使在极端光线条件下也不模糊. 现有的基于事件的人类发展报告方法大致分为两类。 只事件方法直接从事件流重建出模糊而自由的高速HDR视频. 然而,这种方法并没有绝对的强度参考,经常会出出有严重色彩和亮度漂移的视频[44,58,36,57]. 混合事件帧法取而代之的是使用同步LDR帧作为强度锚地,并用事件来补偿被过度或暴露不足的内容. 虽然这种方法制作的HDR视频具有很高的能见度和色彩忠贞度,但大多数现有方法都按照现有LDR框架的时间戳重建了HDR的内容[50、15、38]。

blocks.en: In this work, we explore a different event-frame imaging setting. Instead of reconstructing HDR video either from events alone or through one-to-one HDR reconstruction from individual LDR frames, we ask whether a single LDR frame can serve as the appearance and intensity reference for a temporally expanded HDR sequence, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Specifically, we use the LDR frame to provide absolute color and scene appearance, while the subsequent event stream is used to recover both the temporal evolution of the scene and the missing information in over- or under-exposed regions. In this way, the same event measurements are exploited for both temporal expansion and HDR reconstruction, allowing multiple HDR frames to be generated from only one LDR observation. We refer to this setting as single-reference HDR temporal expansion.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们探索了不同的事件框架成像设定. 我们不单从事件或通过单个 LDR 框架进行一对一的 HDR 重建,而是询问单一 LDR 框架是否能够作为时间上扩大的 HDR 序列的外观和强度参考,如图1所示。 具体地说,我们使用LDR框架来提供绝对的颜色和场景外观,而随后的事件流则用于恢复场景的时间演化和在被过度曝光或接触不足的区域缺失的信息. 这样,就利用同样的事件测量来进行时间扩展和人类发展报告的重建,只从一次长期发展数据观察中产生多种人类发展报告框架。 我们把这一设定称为单一参考的人类发展报告时间扩展。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we propose HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework for single-reference HDR temporal expansion. We use a pretrained Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) model as the spatiotemporal prior and introduce a ControlNet-style event adaptor [ 52 ] to guide the generated dynamics and HDR content. We further decompose training into event-guided LDR video generation and HDR content completion, allowing the model to first learn temporal structure and then recover HDR content.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用HIVE-Diff,作为单一参考人类发展报告时间扩展的视像传播框架。 我们使用预先训练的"稳定视频传播"(SVD)模式作为"先发后发",并引入了ControlNet-tyle事件适配器[52]来指导生成的动态和HDR内容. 我们进一步将培训分为由事件指导的LDR视频生成和HDR内容完成,使模型能够首先学习时间结构,然后恢复HDR内容.

blocks.en: A practical challenge is adapting the framework to real event-camera data, where paired high-frame-rate HDR-event ground truth is extremely scarce. We therefore train on synthetic event-HDR pairs generated with an event simulator [ 19 ] . Simulated events, however, differ from real sensors in noise, contrast thresholds, and event-frame alignment. Since paired LDR videos and event streams are easy to collect, we use them as proxy supervision to fine-tune the event-conditioning modules on real data, with teacher-student distillation preventing feature drift during fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 一个实际的挑战是使该框架适应实际的事件-相机数据,因为在该数据中,配对的高帧率《人类发展报告》-事件地面真相极为稀少。 因此,我们培训合成事件-用模拟事件生成的HDR配对[19]。 然而,模拟事件与真正的传感器在噪音、对比阈值和事件框相接方面有所不同。 由于配对的LDR视频和事件流很容易被收集,我们用它们作为代理监督,在真实数据上微调事件调节模块,在微调时师生分馏防止特征漂移.

blocks.en: We evaluate our framework on synthetic and multiple real-world event datasets. Since existing event-based HDR methods operate under different input-output settings, we benchmark against representative methods under their respective settings. Experiments show that a single LDR reference with events supports temporally expanded HDR reconstruction, and that the proposed adaptation improves quality and temporal stability across real event datasets. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们关于合成和多种现实世界事件数据集的框架。 由于现有的基于事件的《人类发展报告》方法在不同的投入-产出环境中运作,因此,我们参照其各自环境中的代表性方法制定基准。 实验表明,对事件的单一的LDR参考支持了时间上扩大的HDR重建,而拟议的适应则提高了真实事件数据集的质量和时间稳定性. 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: (1) We investigate single-reference HDR temporal expansion, which jointly reconstructs N N HDR frames from one LDR reference and events rather than N N aligned LDR observations.
blocks.zh: (1) 我们调查单一参考的《人类发展报告》时间扩展情况,该扩展情况共同从一个LDR参考和事件中重建国家人类发展报告框架,而不是从NN对LDR的观测结果中重建。

blocks.en: (2) We develop HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that decomposes this task into event-guided LDR video generation and HDR content completion using a pretrained video prior.
blocks.zh: (2)我们开发了HIVE-Diff,一个事件有条件的视频传播框架,将这项任务分解为事件制导的LDR视频生成和HDR内容的完成,使用事先经过训练的视频.

blocks.en: (3) We introduce an HDR-GT-free real-domain adaptation strategy that uses paired LDR-event data and teacher-student distillation to adapt the model to real event statistics and event-frame misalignment.
blocks.zh: (3)我们采用HDR-GT无线实时域调整策略,使用对接的LDR-event数据和师生分馏法来使模型适应真实事件统计和事件框错配.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the HIVE-Diff training and inference pipeline. Stage 1 learns event-guided temporal generation from synthetic LDR-event data, and Stage 2 learns HDR content completion with synthetic HDR supervision. Stage 3 adapts the event adaptor to real event data using LDR-event proxy supervision without HDR ground truth. During inference, the adapted event adaptor is combined with the HDR branch and frozen video diffusion backbone for real-world HDR temporal expansion.
blocks.zh: 图2:HIVE-DIff培训和推论管道概述。 第一阶段从合成的LDR-活动数据中学习事件指导时间生成,第二阶段在合成的HDR监督下学习HDR内容完成. 第3阶段使用LDR-event代理监理,使事件适配器适应真实事件数据,而无需HDR地面真相. 在推论期间,调整后的活动适配器与《人类发展报告》分支和被冻结的视频传播主干线结合,用于现实世界的《人类发展报告》时间扩展。

blocks.en: 2.1 Frame-based HDR Video Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于框架的人类发展报告录像重建

blocks.en: Most frame-based HDR video methods rely on multi-exposure fusion and accurate frame alignment to recover saturated and under-exposed content [ 21 , 54 ] . However, large motion and unreliable observations in saturated or noisy regions can cause misalignment, ghosting, and temporal inconsistency. Learning-based methods improve alignment through coarse-to-fine estimation and feature-level matching [ 20 , 7 , 39 ] , but large motion remains challenging in high-speed scenes. Hardware solutions such as spatially varying or interleaved exposures reduce temporal alignment requirements, but introduce additional sensor complexity and trade-offs in spatial resolution, field of view, or readout bandwidth [ 7 , 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 大部分基于帧的HDR视频方法都依赖于多接触聚和准确的帧对接来恢复饱和和曝光不足的内容 [21,54]. 然而,饱和或吵闹地区的大运动和不可靠的观测可能会造成错位,幽灵和时间不一致. 基于学习的方法通过粗糙到精细的估算和特征级相配[20,7,39]来改进校正,但在高速场景中,大型运动仍然具有挑战性. 硬件解决方案,如空间相异或相隔接触会降低时间相接要求,但在空间分辨率,视域,或读出带宽[7,42]中引入了额外的传感器复杂性和取舍.

blocks.en: 2.2 Event-based HDR Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于活动的人类发展报告 重建

blocks.en: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and a wide effective dynamic range, making them attractive for HDR reconstruction in fast-moving scenes. Event-only methods reconstruct high-speed HDR video directly from events [ 44 , 58 , 36 , 57 ] , but the lack of absolute intensity observations can cause brightness drift, color ambiguity, and temporal flickering. Hybrid event-frame methods instead use LDR frames as intensity and appearance references and events to recover saturated or under-exposed content [ 50 , 15 , 38 , 51 , 5 ] . Most perform one-to-one HDR reconstruction at available LDR timestamps, while several approaches further interpolate between repeated or alternating-exposure observations to produce higher-frame-rate HDR video [ 2 , 37 ] . Closer to our setting, AKF [ 46 ] interpolates HDR intensity between frames with events, but relies on a continuous frame stream and reduces to drifting event integration when only one frame is available; Zhu et al . [ 56 ] and ContinuityCam [ 47 ] reconstruct LDR video from one image and the subsequent events, and Lin et al . [ 26 ] expand a single rolling-shutter image into HDR frames with events. None of them generates multiple HDR frames from a single LDR frame with a learned video prior.
blocks.zh: 事件相机提供高时间分辨率和广泛的有效动态范围,使其在快速移动的场景中对人类发展报告的重建具有吸引力。 事件唯能方法直接从事件[44,58,36,57]重建高速HDR视频,但缺乏绝对强度观测会导致亮度漂移,色彩模糊,时间闪烁. 混合事件帧法取而代之的是使用LDR帧作为强度和外观参考和事件来回收饱和或暴露不足的内容[50,15,38,51,5]. 多数在现有的LDR时间戳上进行一对一的HDR重建,而若干方法则在重复或交替接触观测之间进一步插入,以产生更高帧率的HDR视频[2,37]. AKF[46]将 HDR的强度与事件的帧相接,但依靠连续的帧流,在只有一个帧时减少漂移的事件整合;Zhu等 [56]和Cam相接 [47]从一个图像和随后的事件中重建了LDR视频,而Lin等[26]将单一的滚动-shutter图像扩展为带有事件的HDR帧. 没有一个从一个LDD框架产生多个HDR帧,之前有一个有学识的视频.

blocks.en: Unlike these settings, we study single-reference HDR temporal expansion, where one LDR observation and its corresponding event stream are used to reconstruct multiple HDR frames within a temporal window. This setting retains an absolute appearance reference while reducing the need for an aligned LDR observation at every output timestamp.
blocks.zh: 与这些设置不同,我们研究单参考HDR时间扩展,在一个时间窗口内使用一个LDR观察及其相应的事件流重建多个HDR框架. 此设置保留了绝对的外观参考,同时减少了每个输出时间戳对齐的 LDR 观测的需要.

blocks.en: 2.3 Diffusion Priors for Event-Guided Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.3 事件指导重建的传播历程

blocks.en: Pretrained video diffusion models provide strong spatiotemporal priors for temporally coherent generation from a single image [ 1 , 18 , 17 ] . RE-VDM [ 4 ] and EGVD [ 55 ] steer a frozen video diffusion model with events to generate video from a start frame; our Stage 1 builds on this event-conditioning design. Diffusion priors have also been applied to HDR reconstruction and saturated-region recovery [ 14 , 43 , 51 ] , but at existing frame timestamps. HIVE-Diff connects the two with a second ControlNet for HDR content completion and an adaptation stage for real sensors.
blocks.zh: 预受训练的视频传播模型为从单一图像[1, 18, 17] 产生时间上一致的生成提供了很强的spatiotepotors前传. RE-VDM[4]和EGVD[55] 引导一个被冻结的视频传播模型与事件一起从起始框架生成视频;我们的第一阶段基于这个事件调节设计. 《人类发展报告》的重建和饱和地区复苏也应用了传播前科[14、43、51],但采用现有的帧时间戳。 HIVE-Diff将两者连接到第二个ControlNet,用于HDR内容的完成和真实传感器的适应阶段.

blocks.en: 2.4 Real-World Adaptation for Event-based Vision
blocks.zh: 2.4 现实世界适应基于事件的愿景

blocks.en: Models trained on simulated events often degrade on real sensors because of differences in noise, contrast thresholds, event rates, and other sensor characteristics [ 11 ] . Domain and test-time adaptation have therefore been explored for event-based vision [ 6 ] . For HDR video reconstruction, however, paired real events and high-frame-rate HDR ground truth are rarely available. We therefore adapt the event-conditioning modules with paired real LDR videos and events as proxy supervision ( Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 接受模拟事件训练的模型往往会因为噪音、对比阈值、事件率和其他传感器特性的不同而退化在真正的传感器上[11]。 因此,探索了基于事件的愿景领域和试验时间的适应性[6]。 然而,对于《人类发展报告》的录像重建来说,成对的真正事件和高帧率的《人类发展报告》的地面真相很少能得到。 因此,我们调整了事件调节模块,将真实的LDR视频和事件配对为代理监督(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架概览

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Training strategies on synthetic dataset. Stage 1: We encode the randomly exposed LDR reference and the LDR video into latents, add noise to the video latents, and condition a pretrained denoiser via an event adaptor (event encoder + ControlNet 1) to generate LDR video. Stage 2: We freeze a copy of the trained event adaptor, insert the trainable ControlNet 2, and switch the target to normalized PQ-encoded HDR video latents. We also optionally feed previously denoised latents to encourage temporal consistency across video clips
blocks.zh: 图3:合成数据集培训战略。 阶段 1:我们将随机曝光的LDR参考和LDR视频编码为潜伏,给视频潜伏添加噪音,并通过事件适配器(event encoder + ControlNet 1)对预受训练的denoiser设定条件以生成LDR视频. 阶段 2:我们冻结训练有素的事件适配器的副本,插入可训练的控制网2,并切换目标,使PQ编码的HDR视频潜想正常化. 我们还可选地提供以前虚化的潜质,以鼓励视频片段的时间一致性。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , HIVE-Diff realizes single-reference HDR temporal expansion through three stages: event-guided temporal generation, HDR content completion, and real-domain adaptation. This decomposition learns temporal dynamics and HDR reconstruction from synthetic data, while adapting the event-conditioning module to real sensor characteristics without requiring real HDR ground truth.
blocks.zh: 如图所出. 2,HIVE-Diff实现单一参考HDR时间扩展,分为三个阶段:事件指导时间生成,HDR内容完成,以及实际领域适应. 这种分解从合成数据中学习了时间动态和HDR重建,同时使事件调节模块适应真实的传感器特性而不需要真正的HDR地面真实性.

blocks.en: In Stage 1, we train an event adaptor on synthetic LDR-event pairs to guide a frozen pretrained video diffusion model in generating an LDR sequence from a single reference. In Stage 2, we freeze the adaptor and train an HDR ControlNet with synthetic HDR supervision to recover HDR content while preserving the learned temporal structure. In Stage 3, we adapt only the event adaptor to real data, using paired real LDR videos and event streams as proxy supervision and a frozen synthetic-trained copy as teacher to prevent feature drift. At inference, the adapted adaptor, the synthetic-trained HDR ControlNet, and the frozen backbone together reconstruct temporally expanded HDR video from real event-camera data.
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段,我们用合成的LDR-event对来训练一个事件适配器,指导一个被冷冻的预先训练的视频传播模型从一个单一的参考物生成LDR序列. 在第二阶段,我们冻结了适配器,并培训一个HDR控制网,对HDR进行合成监督,以收回HDR的内容,同时保留学到的时间结构。 在第三阶段,我们只根据真实数据调整事件适配器,使用配对真实的LDR视频和事件流作为代理监督,并作为教师使用被冻结的合成训练的拷贝来防止特性漂移. 推论,经过改造的适配器、经过合成训练的《人类发展报告》控制网和被冻结的骨干一起从真实的事件-摄像头数据中重建暂时扩大的《人类发展报告》视频。

blocks.en: 3.2 Training on Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 合成数据培训

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 3 , synthetic training is decomposed into two stages. Stage 1 learns event-guided temporal generation in the LDR domain, while Stage 2 builds on the learned temporal representation for HDR content completion.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,合成训练分解为两个阶段。 第1阶段学习LDR域内的事件指导时间生成,而第2阶段则借鉴了对完成《人类发展报告》内容的学习时间表述。

blocks.en: Stage 1: Event-guided temporal generation. We use the pretrained SVD image-to-video denoiser as the video prior and keep its weights frozen to preserve the pretrained spatiotemporal representation. A trainable event adaptor, consisting of an event encoder and a ControlNet-style branch, injects event-derived control signals into the frozen denoiser [ 4 , 51 , 52 ] . For each training clip, we render an LDR video at a randomly sampled exposure and use its first frame as the reference. The LDR video and reference frame are encoded by the pretrained VAE into the target latent 𝐙 0 \mathbf{Z}_{0} and reference latent 𝐙 c \mathbf{Z}_{c} , respectively. Following the standard SVD/EDM training formulation [ 22 , 1 ] , the target latent is perturbed with Gaussian noise, while the reference latent is repeated along the temporal dimension and concatenated with the noisy video latent as input to the denoiser and event adaptor.

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Data Synthesis and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训数据综合和执行细节

blocks.en: We use the 16-bit color-graded HDR TIFF sequences from HdM-HDR-2014 [ 9 ] as the source HDR data. The PQ-encoded pixel values are normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and used as the HDR supervision. Following the exposure-rendering procedure provided with the dataset, we synthesize LDR observations at randomly sampled exposure values. We further apply randomly sampled global camera motion to the video sequences so that static scene regions also produce temporal intensity changes, and generate the corresponding event streams using the v2e event simulator [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自HdM-HDR-2014 [9] 的16位色彩级HDR TIFF序列作为源HDR数据. PQ-encoded像素值被正常化为 [0, 1] [0, 1]并用作HDR监督. 按照数据集提供的接触-提交程序,我们以随机抽样的接触值合成了LDR观测结果。 我们进一步将随机抽样的全球相机运动应用于视频序列,使静态场景区域也产生时间强度变化,并使用v2e事件模拟器生成相应的事件流 [19].

blocks.en: We train two variants of HIVE-Diff with clip lengths of 5 and 20 frames at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution with 4 event bins on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU. Optimizer settings, learning rates, and step counts are given in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们训练两个HIVE-Diff的变体,剪接长度为5和20帧,在512×512 512\times 512分辨率上有一个单NVIDIA L40S GPU上的4个事件箱. 优化设置,学习率,分级计数在补充材料中给出.

blocks.en: Because no existing method jointly addresses single-reference HDR temporal expansion, we compare representative event-based HDR methods. EventHDR [ 57 ] uses events only, whereas NeurImg-HDR [ 15 ] , HDRev [ 50 ] , and HDRev-Diff [ 51 ] perform one-to-one LDR-event HDR reconstruction. An input-matched cascade would first predict the missing LDR frames and make its performance depend on both LDR generation and HDR reconstruction. We therefore evaluate each one-to-one method under its native and more favorable protocol—an aligned LDR input at every output timestamp—while HIVE-Diff uses only the initial frame. We also tried an input-matched variant of EventHDR that fits a per-window affine brightness and color correction of its output to the LDR reference at t = 0 t{=}0 . On EventHDR this raises its PSNR by only about 1 dB and changes LPIPS little, because the anchor corrects the global level but not the structural errors of the event-only reconstruction; we therefore do not report it as a separate row. We report F ∗ for the reference-aligned first output frame, and 5 × \times /20 × \times for full-sequence averages of the variants that generate 5 or 20 HDR frames per LDR reference. All baselines are retrained on the same synthetic data with identical LDR rendering and event simulation protocols using official implementations and recommended settings.
blocks.zh: 由于目前没有一种方法共同处理单一参考的人类发展报告时间扩展问题,我们比较了基于事件的有代表性的人类发展报告方法。 事件HDR[57]只使用事件,而NeurImg-HDR[15],HDRev [50],和HDRev-Diff[51]则进行一对一的LDR-活动HDR重建. 与输入相匹配的级联将首先预测缺失的路德网框架,使其性能依赖于路德网生成和HDR重建. 因此,我们根据其原生的、更有利的协议来评估每一种一对一的方法——在每个输出时间戳上都使用一致的LDR输入,而HIVE-diff只使用初始框架。 我们还尝试了“事件人类发展报告”的输入相匹配的变体,该变体符合每个窗口的外观亮度,并将输出的颜色校正到“路德”参考值为:t=0 t==0。 在事件HDR上,这只提高了大约1分贝的PSNR,而很少改变LPIPS,因为主播纠正了全球层面,而不是仅事件重建的结构错误;因此,我们不将其作为一行单独报告。 我们报告F * 用于参考对齐的第一个产出框架,5 × 时 / 20 × 时用于每个 LDR 参考生成 5 个或 20 个 HDR 框架的变量的全序列平均值。 所有基线都使用相同的合成数据进行再培训,同时使用相同的LDR渲染和事件模拟协议,使用正式执行和建议设置.

blocks.en: We first conduct a controlled synthetic evaluation on the held-out “poker_fullshot” sequence from HdM-HDR-2014 [ 9 ] , where HDR ground truth enables direct assessment of reconstruction fidelity and temporal consistency; broader real-world generalization is evaluated in Sec. 4.2 . As shown in Tab. 1 , under the first-frame protocol (F ∗ ), our method achieves the best performance across all frame-wise metrics compared with the one-to-one hybrid HDR baselines. The 5 × \times model remains close to F ∗ , while 20 × \times shows larger degradation in PSNR, SSIM and CIEDE2000. For temporal consistency, the 5 × \times and 20 × \times variants achieve E warp E_{\mathrm{warp}} values of 0.0059 and 0.0091, respectively, ranking first and second among the evaluated methods.
blocks.zh: 我们首先对HdM-HDR-2014年[9]的“poker_fulshot”序列进行控制下的综合评估,HDR的地面真相使得能够直接评估重建的忠诚性和时间一致性;更广泛的现实世界概况在第4.2节中加以评价。 如附件1所示,根据第一个框架协议(F ∗),我们的方法与一对一混合人类发展报告基线相比,在所有框架指标方面都取得了最佳业绩。 5×x\times模型仍然接近于F *,而20×x\times在PSNR,SSIM和CIEDE2000中显示出更大的降解. 对于时间一致性,5×x\times和20×xxx\times的变体分别实现Ewarp E_{\-mathrm{warp}} 值为0.0059和0.0091,在被评价方法中排名第一和第二.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 further shows qualitative comparisons under over- and under-exposed conditions. EventHDR [ 57 ] produces grayscale reconstructions without reliable color information. HDRev [ 50 ] and NeurImg-HDR [ 15 ] recover coarse structures when events are sufficiently informative, but exhibit color or brightness distortions in severely exposed regions and degrade when event information is sparse. HDRev-Diff [ 51 ] generates perceptually plausible content, although some reconstructed details deviate from the ground truth. In comparison, our method better preserves color and structural fidelity while reconstructing multiple HDR frames from the same LDR reference and event stream.

blocks.en: 4.2 Real-World Evaluation with HDR Ground Truth
blocks.zh: 4.2 《人类发展报告》中的真实世界评价

blocks.en: We first evaluate real-world performance on the EventHDR dataset [ 57 ] , which contains paired high-frame-rate grayscale HDR videos and real event streams. We render over-exposed LDR clips from the HDR frames at EV=+4 and use the first LDR frame of each temporal window as the reference. To evaluate generalization after real-domain adaptation, we use 19 sequences exclusively for fine-tuning and five disjoint, unseen sequences for evaluation. Fine-tuning uses the rendered LDR sequences and corresponding real events, while the original HDR values are not used as reconstruction targets. Compared with the synthetic data, EventHDR exhibits different event statistics and imperfect event–frame alignment, allowing us to evaluate adaptation to real sensor characteristics.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在事件HDR数据集上评价现实世界的表现[57],该数据集包含成对的高帧率灰度HDR视频和真实事件流. 我们从EVQQ4的人类发展报告框中提取过度曝光的LDR剪辑,并以每个时间窗口的第一个LDR帧作为参考. 为了评价在实际领域调整后的一般化,我们使用19个序列专门进行微调,并使用5个不相连的、看不见的序列进行评价。 微调使用已渲染的LDR序列和相应的真实事件,而原始的HDR值则不作为重建目标. 与合成数据相比,事件HDR显示了不同的事件统计和不完善的事件-框架对接,使我们能够评价适应真正的传感器特性的情况。

blocks.en: Quantitative results are reported in Tab. 2 . Fine-tuning with LDR-event proxy supervision consistently improves reconstruction quality on the five unseen test sequences. For Ours (F ∗ ), fine-tuning improves all frame-wise metrics, including PSNR, SSI-PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and CIEDE2000. The adapted 5 × \times model maintains frame-wise quality close to F ∗ while achieving the best temporal consistency. The 20 × \times model supports a longer temporal horizon with some degradation in frame-wise quality, while retaining the second-best temporal consistency. Both variants outperform the baselines in temporal consistency despite using only a single LDR reference per temporal window, demonstrating generalization to unseen real sequences.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation on Real Data without HDR Ground Truth
blocks.zh: 4.3 对没有《人类发展报告》的实际数据的评价

blocks.en: We further evaluate our method on DSEC [ 12 ] , HS-ERGB [ 41 ] , and our self-collected event-frame dataset, which provide paired LDR RGB videos and events but no HDR ground truth. For each dataset, we use non-overlapping adaptation and evaluation segments. The event adaptor is fine-tuned on paired LDR-event data from the adaptation segments, while all reported results are computed on held-out segments unseen during fine-tuning. This enables real-domain adaptation without HDR supervision.

blocks.en: 5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5 读取研究

blocks.en: We evaluate the effects of real-domain fine-tuning and teacher–student distillation on the EventHDR dataset [ 57 ] , as summarized in Tab. 4 . Without fine-tuning, the model is less adapted to real event statistics and event–frame misalignment. Fine-tuning without distillation improves SSI-PSNR and temporal consistency, but degrades PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and CIEDE2000, consistent with feature drift during adaptation. Adding teacher–student distillation substantially improves PSNR and overall reconstruction fidelity while preserving the same temporal warping error. Although the model without distillation obtains a higher SSI-PSNR, the full model achieves the best PSNR and better overall quality. Additional qualitative analyses of real-domain fine-tuning and ablations on previous-latent conditioning are provided in the supplementary material.

blocks.zh: 6. 限制和结论

blocks.en: HIVE-Diff relies on iterative diffusion denoising, and Tab. 5 reports its inference cost. Our method is about 2.3 × \times faster per frame than HDRev-Diff, but still around 100 × \times slower than feed-forward methods. Few-step distillation and feature caching are promising ways to close this gap.
blocks.zh: HIVE-Diff依赖迭代传播去名,而Tab. 5则报告其推论成本. 我们的方法大约是每帧2.3×\时速比HDRev-Diff快,但仍在100×分左右\时速比feed-forward方法慢. 很少分步蒸馏和地物缓冲是缩小这一差距的有希望的方法。

blocks.en: Beyond inference cost, HIVE-Diff has four limitations. First, fidelity decreases gradually with distance from the reference: the 20 × \times model loses about 2 dB in SSI-PSNR from the first to the last output frame on both HdM-HDR-2014 and EventHDR (per-frame curves in the supplementary material). Second, where a saturated region produces no events, such as a static blown-out sky, its content comes from the video prior alone and is plausible rather than measured. Third, previous-latent conditioning smooths clip boundaries, but brightness and color drift still accumulate over long sequences. Fourth, adaptation is performed once per sensor with a few LDR-event sequences; generalization to an unseen camera without adaptation is not evaluated.
blocks.zh: 除了推论成本之外,HIVE-Diff有四个局限性. 首先,忠诚度随着与参考的距离而逐渐减少:20×\times模型在SSI-PSNR中从HdM-HDR-2014和Event HDR(补充材料中的每帧曲线)的第一到最后一个产出框架损失了大约2分贝. 第二,如果饱和区域不产生任何事件,例如静态被吹出天空,其内容仅出自先前的视频,是可信的,而不是衡量的。 第三,前相位调能平滑地进行剪接边界,但亮度和颜色漂移仍然在长序上积累. 第四,每个传感器在进行适应时,要使用几个LDR-event序列;不进行适应,一般化为看不见相机不进行评估。

blocks.en: In this work, we studied single-reference HDR temporal expansion, reconstructing multiple HDR frames from one LDR reference and events, and developed HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that combines event-guided temporal generation with HDR content completion and adapts to real sensors through proxy-supervised, distillation-regularized fine-tuning without HDR ground truth. Experiments on synthetic and real event datasets show strong reconstruction quality, temporal consistency, and robust real-domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们研究了单一参考HDR时间扩展,从一个LDD参考和事件中重建了多个HDR框架,并开发了HIVE-DIff,这是一个事件有条件的视频传播框架,将事件引导时间生成与HDR内容完成相结合,并通过代理监督,分馏-规范化的微调来适应真实的传感器,而无需HDR地面真相. 关于合成和真实事件数据集的实验显示,重建质量强、时间一致性强、实际领域适应性强。

Previous-latent conditioning can be viewed as a short-term memory that
promotes local consistency between adjacent clips. However, it does not
explicitly constrain the global appearance of the entire sequence.
Consequently, small brightness and color deviations may accumulate
during long autoregressive generation, resulting in residual flickering
even when individual clip boundaries are locally smooth. Similar
long-horizon consistency issues have been studied in recent long-video
diffusion methods, where short-term inter-clip memory is complemented by
long-term appearance preservation [ 16 ] .

blocks.en:
Importantly, subsequent clips may also receive newly observed LDR frames
and event measurements. Therefore, the HDR content of a new clip is
expected to update as the scene and observations evolve, and not all
cross-clip appearance changes should be suppressed. The key challenge is
to distinguish observation-driven content updates from undesired
generation drift. A promising extension of HIVE-Diff is thus to combine
the previous latent with a dynamically updated appearance memory derived
from the available LDR observations, rather than relying on a fixed
appearance anchor. Overlapping-window generation with latent, feature,
or photometric consistency could further suppress residual flickering
while allowing new LDR and event evidence to modify the reconstructed
HDR content. Long-video diffusion techniques based on temporal memory
and windowed generation [ 16 , 34 ] provide useful directions for this extension.

blocks.en:
Tab. 5 of the main paper reports model size, inference time per output
frame, computational cost, and peak GPU memory of HIVE-Diff and the
event-based HDR baselines HDRev [ 50 ] ,
NeurImg-HDR [ 15 ] , EventHDR [ 57 ] , and
HDRev-Diff [ 51 ] , profiled at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution on
a single NVIDIA L40S GPU. HIVE-Diff uses the 5 × \times model with 25-step

blocks.en:
Further acceleration could be achieved through two complementary
directions. First, recent few-step video diffusion distillation methods
can compress a multi-step denoising trajectory into only a few sampling
steps [ 8 ] , suggesting that the current 25-step HIVE-Diff
sampler could potentially be distilled to substantially fewer steps.
Second, training-free feature caching can reduce the computation within
each remaining denoising step by reusing redundant intermediate features
across adjacent timesteps [ 31 ] . Since HIVE-Diff also
uses CFG, CFG-aware caching methods such as FasterCache [ 30 ] are particularly relevant because they further
exploit redundancy between the conditional and unconditional branches.
Combining few-step distillation with feature/CFG caching is therefore a
promising direction for reducing HIVE-Diff inference latency, although
the achievable speedup and its effect on HDR reconstruction fidelity and
temporal consistency require dedicated evaluation.
